sentences.en: I visited him at intervals during my stay in Paris.
sentences.zh: 我在巴黎逗留期间隔三差五地去看望他。

sentences.en: The Olympic Games take place at intervals of four years.
sentences.zh: 奥运会每四年举行一次。

sentences.en: We make it a rule to get together at intervals.

senses.zh: 间隔，休息，休息时间，(数学)区间，(音乐)音程，间距
